explanation: Q1 selects drinkers who only like all beers served at the bars they frequent, while Q2 selects drinkers who both frequent a bar and like a beer that is served somewhere. A drinker who frequents a bar with some beers they don't like (but likes others) is in Q2 but not Q1. A drinker who doesn't frequent any bar is in Q1 but not Q2.
counterexample_dsp: Drinker Alice frequents Bar1, which serves BeerA (liked) and BeerB (not liked). Drinker Bob does not frequent any bar. Q1 includes Bob (no frequented bars) and excludes Alice (Bar1 serves BeerB she doesn't like). Q2 includes Alice (likes BeerA served at Bar1) and excludes Bob (no frequents).
